title.zh: 将南三宝颜省唐马里亚诺马科斯市镇的名称变更为索米诺特市镇的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Don Mariano Marcos, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur, to Municipality of Sominot
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Don Mariano Marcos, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur, to Municipality of Sominot

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6684_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the municipality of Don Mariano Marcos, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, is hereby changed to Municipality of Sominot.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
